notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl/urllib with a real-browser User-Agent, de-DE Accept-Language) succeeded for every page - all category pages are server-side rendered with the target content in the initial HTML (no Playwright/CDP or Claude-in-Chrome needed). robots.txt (User-agent:* and the anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web block) disallows /c/*, /products/*, /collections/*, /api/*, /customer*, /all-products but the site's actual category pages live at bare top-level slugs (e.g. /dekokissen/, /aufbewahrungsboxen/) which are not covered by any Disallow rule, so tier (a)/(b) fetches were permitted; tier (c) was avoided anyway per the anthropic-ai block and was disconnected regardless. TREE: built from union of sitemap-categories.xml (602 category URLs) keyword-scanned for textile/storage German terms, plus each hub page's own server-rendered sub-nav link chips (Textilien/Heimtextilien hub, Aufbewahrung hub, Schlafzimmertextilien, Badtextilien, Kuechentextilien-Tischwaesche, Kindertextilien, Weihnachtliche Textilien, Bad-Aufbewahrung, Kinderzimmer-Aufbewahrung, Kuechenaufbewahrung, Kleinaufbewahrung-Organizer, Teppiche hub all fetched and their internal href chips parsed). QTY: extracted from the server-rendered footer text '<shown> von <total> Produkten werden angezeigt' present on every listing page (also cross-checked against the filter-bar '<total> Produkte' chip) - both matched on every page checked; this is the site's own exact displayed total, not the unreliable Algolia/RSC-flight-encoded nbHits value embedded elsewhere in the HTML (that value proved unusable - it is stored via indirect numeric references in a React-Flight serialization and does not reliably co-locate with its key). EXCLUDED and why: (1) Furniture-storage crossover categories reached from the Aufbewahrung hub (Kommoden&Sideboards, Regale, Schraenke, Garderoben&Schuhschraenke, Moebel-mit-Stauraum) - these are Furniture-category pages tagged with a storage attribute, Furniture boundary applies, Furniture.xlsx is out of scope and already validated. (2) Bathroom fixture/accessory pages under Bad-Aufbewahrung (Handtuchhalter, Seifenspender, Toilettenbuersten, Toilettenpapierhalter, Zahnputzbecher, Kosmetikeimer, Seifen-Cremes, Badezimmer-Deko) - fixtures/toiletries/decor, not storage containers. (3) Trash bins (Muelleimer, Kuechenmuelleimer) and bread baskets (Brotkoerbe) - waste receptacles and Kitchen&Dining serving items, not storage/organization products. (4) Kinder-Wandaufbewahrung (children's wall coat hooks) - wall hardware, not container storage. (5) Wickelauflagen-und-Wickelaufsaetze (changing pad/mat covers) - primarily a padded nursery-furniture accessory, not core textile. (6) /buerobedarf/ - confirmed duplicate of /buero-organizer/ (identical title 'Buero & Schreibtisch Organizer' and identical qty=140), one record kept. (7) /kissen/ - canonical-redirects to /dekokissen/ (same qty 894), duplicate dropped. (8) Rug and cushion attribute-facet pages (Teppiche-nach-Raum/Farbe/Material/Muster/Florhoehe, Fruehlingskissen/Sommerkissen/Herbstkissen/Einfarbige-Kissen/Gemusterte-Kissen) - confirmed these are re-sorted/filtered views of the same base catalog rather than a true subcategory partition (e.g. Teppiche-nach-Raum and Teppiche-nach-Form both show the identical unfiltered total of 781, matching the parent /teppiche/ page exactly; the seasonal/color/pattern cushion facets sum to far more than the base Dekokissen total of 894, proving heavy overlap) - kept only the by-shape rug breakdown (Rectangular/Round/Runner/Organic, which does partition close to the 781 total) and the functionally distinct Sofakissen/Bodenkissen/Sitzkissen/Kissenfuellungen/Outdoor-Kissen/Outdoor-Sitzpolster as genuine standalone cushion types. (9) Antirutschmatten (rug anti-slip underlay pads) - a rug accessory, not itself a floor-covering product. (10) Wohnaccessoires, Buchstuetzen, Vasen, Deko-Objekte, Deko-Schalen, Deko-Tabletts, Spiegel, Kerzenhalter, Wanddeko, Blumentoepfe, Raumduft-Kerzen, Serviettenhalter, Tierbedarf - purely decorative/fixture/pet items excluded per both rule files' Decorative Accessories / Home Fragrance / Pet boundaries. Two low-confidence review items flagged: Wine Racks (Weinregal, storage.md does not explicitly list wine racks) and Cushion Fillings (Kissenfuellungen, a fabric cushion-insert component). No blockers encountered; all figures are the site's own displayed totals with an evidence string per row.
